project_title: Establish, Monitor, and Maintain Native Forest Habitat for the Fargo-Moorhead Metropolitan Flood Risk Management Project

project_summary.purpose: To perform all necessary actions to establish, monitor, and maintain native forest habitat as part of the environmental mitigation requirements for the Fargo-Moorhead Metropolitan Flood Risk Management Project.

total_work_area.base_acres: To be specified in Performance Work Statement (PWS)
total_work_area.option_acres: To be specified in Performance Work Statement (PWS)

work_locations.description: Designated environmental mitigation areas within the Fargo-Moorhead project footprint.

scope_categories.description: Includes soil preparation, invasive species control, and planting of native trees, shrubs, and understory species according to the specified planting plan.
Conduct periodic site inspections to monitor plant survival, growth rates, invasive species presence, and overall habitat health. Submit detailed annual monitoring reports.
Perform required maintenance activities including, but not limited to, weed control (mechanical and chemical), pest management, replanting of failed stock, and protection of seedlings.

deliverables.name: Annual Monitoring Report
deliverables.format: PDF with supporting data and photographs

key_requirements: Contractor must possess all required state licenses for herbicide/pesticide application in both North Dakota and Minnesota.
Compliance with all federal, state, and local environmental laws and regulations.
Personnel must have demonstrated experience in large-scale ecological restoration.

insurance.general_liability: Standard Commercial General Liability as per FAR Part 28
insurance.auto_liability: Standard Automobile Liability as per FAR Part 28
insurance.workers_comp: Workers' Compensation as required by state law (ND & MN)

compliance.wage_determination: Federal Contractor Standards (SCA or Walsh-Healey as applicable)

submission.address: USACE, St. Paul District, Attn: Contracting Division, 180 5th Street East, Suite 700, St. Paul, MN 55101
submission.due_date: Information not provided in solicitation summary
